_comment: Regauntless base classes — transcribed VERBATIM from SRD 3.5 (OGL), d20srd.org/srd/classes/<class>.htm (Barbarian, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Fighter, Monk, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, Sorcerer, Wizard). Per character-creation.md a CLASS is NOT a special system: it is one GRANT-SOURCE BUNDLE that injects into the one unified sheet — Hit Die (pool contribution) + BAB progression (-> fire-rate per combat.md) + save progression + weapon/armor/shield proficiencies + class-skill list + skill points/level + a level-by-level GRANTED-FEATURE list (the 'class features', which are just class-granted FEATS, source-agnostic — no feat is OWNED by a class). SCOPE: the core table + features of each class, verbatim-faithful. Spellcasting is captured as a feature NAME + a note that the slot/known tables defer to the caster layer (character-creation.md's caster-progression envelope: full vs half/partial vs none). PROCESS mirrors feats/skills/abilities/bestiary: each entry has an 'srd' block (verbatim) + a 'regauntless' interpretation layer. The 6 Regauntless heroes map onto these: Warrior=Fighter, Valkyrie~Fighter/Paladin (best armor, tanky), Wizard=Wizard/Sorcerer, Elf~Ranger/Rogue (fast ranged); Cleric/Monk/Rogue/Paladin referenced in the build-space examples. Validate JSON after every edit. This is faithful DATA-ENTRY, not redesign.

srd.hitDie: string (e.g. 'd10') — the class's Hit Die size
srd.skillPointsPerLevel: string (e.g. '2 + Int'); x4 at 1st level per SRD
srd.classSkills: [string] — the class-skill list (key ability noted where SRD does)
srd.features: [ { level:int, name, summary: 1-2 sentence verbatim-faithful } ] — the level-by-level granted features (= class-granted feats)

regauntless.note: SHORT — which features map CLEAN (BAB->fire-rate, HD->pool, proficiencies), which REINTERPRET (abilities needing real-time mapping), which are NO-OP or CASTER-LAYER (spellcasting -> defer, note caster-progression envelope). Plus which Regauntless hero(es) this class maps onto.

_grantBundleNote.note: A class bundle = Hit Die + BAB + saves + proficiencies + class-skill list + skill-points/level + the granted-feature list. BAB->fire-rate cadence (combat.md: 'BAB +6/+1 = two attacks per 6-second round' becomes a fire-rate cooldown; higher BAB = faster cadence; we keep the rate, drop the turn queue). HD->the party-pool contribution (combat-model.md Con->party-pool MAX; HD size is the per-level pool slice). Proficiencies map clean to what weapons/armor the hero can use. Saves (Fort/Ref/Will good=+2 at L1 rising to +12 at L20; poor=+0 rising to +6) are sheet-level inputs to the ±5 circumstance/resist math. Spellcasting (per-day + known tables) is a CASTER-LAYER concern — deferred here; the envelope (full caster = Cleric/Druid/Sorcerer/Wizard/Bard; half/partial = Paladin/Ranger starting L4 at caster level = 1/2 class level; none = martial) is the character-creation.md 'grant carries its own power envelope' rule.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.summary: A barbarian's land speed is faster than the norm for his race by +10 feet, when wearing no/light/medium armor and not carrying a heavy load.

features.name: Illiteracy
features.summary: Barbarians are the only characters who do not automatically know how to read and write; a barbarian may spend 2 skill points to gain literacy.

features.name: Rage
features.summary: A barbarian can fly into a rage (1/day at 1st, +1 per four levels to 6/day at 20th), gaining +4 Str, +4 Con, +2 morale on Will saves and -2 AC; lasts 3 + newly-improved Con mod rounds, then fatigued.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: A barbarian retains his Dexterity bonus to AC even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker (but not if immobilized).

features.name: Trap Sense
features.summary: +1 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid traps and +1 dodge bonus to AC against traps; rises +1 every three levels (6th, 9th, 12th, 15th, 18th).

features.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: A barbarian can no longer be flanked (denying a rogue the flanking sneak attack unless the attacker has four+ more rogue levels).

features.name: Damage Reduction
features.summary: Gains DR 1/—, subtracting from each instance of weapon/natural-attack damage; rises +1 at 10th and every three levels (13th, 16th, 19th).

features.name: Greater Rage
features.summary: Rage bonuses to Str and Con increase to +6 and the morale bonus on Will saves to +3 (AC penalty stays -2).

features.name: Indomitable Will
features.summary: While raging, gains +4 on Will saves to resist enchantment spells, stacking with the rage morale bonus.

features.name: Tireless Rage
features.summary: A barbarian no longer becomes fatigued at the end of his rage.

features.name: Mighty Rage
features.summary: Rage bonuses to Str and Con increase to +8 and the morale bonus on Will saves to +4 (AC penalty stays -2).

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d12 (biggest pool slice), full BAB (fastest fire-rate cadence), martial+medium proficiencies. REINTERPRET: Rage = a timed buff stance (burst Str/Con up = shot-damage up + pool up, AC down) with a per-encounter cooldown and a fatigue debuff tail — maps onto combat-model ability FEEL as an activated window. Fast Movement = flat +move. DR = flat subtract from incoming damage (clean). Uncanny/Improved Uncanny Dodge & Trap Sense partly no-op (no flat-footed/flanking/AoO/trap-save subsystem yet) — reinterpret as don't-lose-Dex-dodge / can't-be-surrounded-bonus if ever surfaced. Not a Regauntless hero but the rage-berserker flavor could tint a Warrior background.

proficiencies.weapons: All simple weapons, plus longsword, rapier, sap, short sword, shortbow, and whip.
proficiencies.armor: Light armor (can cast bard spells in light armor without arcane spell failure).
proficiencies.shields: Shields (except tower shields), but shields incur arcane spell failure.

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A bard casts arcane spells (Cha-based) from the bard list spontaneously, without preparation; limited spells known; save DC = 10 + spell level + Cha mod.

features.name: Bardic Knowledge
features.summary: A special check (bard level + Int mod) to know relevant information about notable people, legendary items, or noteworthy places.

features.name: Bardic Music
features.summary: Once per day per bard level, a bard uses song/poetics to produce magical effects on those around him; each ability needs a minimum level and Perform ranks.

features.name: Countersong
features.summary: With 3+ Perform ranks, a bard can counter magical effects that depend on sound; allies within 30 ft may use his Perform check in place of their save.

features.name: Fascinate
features.summary: With 3+ Perform ranks, a bard fascinates one creature (plus one more per three levels past 1st) within 90 ft, holding it quiet and attentive (Will save negates).

features.name: Inspire Courage
features.summary: With 3+ Perform ranks, allies who hear him gain a +1 morale bonus against charm/fear and +1 on attack and weapon damage rolls (+2 at 8th, +3 at 14th, +4 at 20th).

features.name: Inspire Competence
features.summary: With 6+ Perform ranks, grants an ally within 30 ft a +2 competence bonus on skill checks while he keeps performing.

features.name: Suggestion
features.summary: With 9+ Perform ranks, a bard can make a suggestion (as the spell) to a creature he has already fascinated (Will save negates).

features.name: Inspire Greatness
features.summary: With 12+ Perform ranks, grants an ally (plus one more per three levels past 9th) 2 bonus Hit Dice, +2 attack, and +1 on Fortitude saves.

features.name: Song of Freedom
features.summary: With 15+ Perform ranks, a bard can create a break enchantment effect on a single target within 30 ft (1 minute of performance).

features.name: Inspire Heroics
features.summary: With 18+ Perform ranks, inspires himself or an ally (plus one more per three levels past 15th) with a +4 morale bonus on saves and +4 dodge bonus to AC.

features.name: Mass Suggestion
features.summary: With 21+ Perform ranks, makes a suggestion simultaneously to any number of creatures he has already fascinated.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d6 (small pool), 3/4 BAB, light-armor proficiency. CASTER-LAYER: arcane spells (Cha) spontaneous, full-known-but-limited progression -> defer to caster layer (envelope: a 'secondary'/support arcane caster). REINTERPRET: the bardic-music family = aura buffs (Inspire Courage -> party +dmg/+save aura; Inspire Competence/Greatness -> ally buffs; Fascinate/Suggestion -> crowd-control debuffs on enemies) — high-value for a horde battler if we ever add a buff/aura system. Not one of the 4 heroes, but a natural support-background flavor.

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A cleric casts divine spells (Wis-based), prepared in advance from the cleric list, plus one domain spell per spell level; save DC = 10 + spell level + Wis mod.

features.name: Aura
features.summary: A cleric of a chaotic/evil/good/lawful deity (or alignment domain) has a particularly powerful aura of that alignment.

features.name: Deity, Domains, and Domain Spells
features.summary: A cleric chooses two domains, each granting a domain spell per castable level and a granted power.

features.name: Spontaneous Casting
features.summary: A good cleric can lose a prepared (non-domain) spell to spontaneously cast a cure spell of the same level or lower; an evil cleric casts inflict spells instead.

features.name: Turn or Rebuke Undead
features.summary: Channels faith through a holy symbol to turn/destroy (good) or rebuke/command (evil) undead, a number of times per day equal to 3 + Cha modifier.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d8 (mid pool), 3/4 BAB, FULL armor+shield proficiency (surprisingly tanky), Heal is a class skill (the revive role, skills.json). CASTER-LAYER: divine spells (Wis), full prepared progression + domains + spontaneous cure/inflict -> defer; this is the FULL divine envelope (the 'devotee' in character-creation.md's three-ways-to-cast example; cf. background 'dabbler' and rogue UMD). REINTERPRET: Turn Undead = an anti-undead channel burst (3+Cha/day) — maps to a limited-use AoE vs the undead enemy family (bestiary.json). Referenced hero: the party's healer/divine-caster slot.

proficiencies.weapons: Club, dagger, dart, quarterstaff, scimitar, sickle, shortspear, sling, and spear (plus natural attacks of wild-shape forms).
proficiencies.armor: Light and medium armor, but no metal armor (padded, leather, or hide only). Prohibited gear disables spells/abilities for 24 hours.

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A druid casts divine spells (Wis-based), prepared in advance from the druid list; no domains; save DC = 10 + spell level + Wis mod.

features.name: Spontaneous Casting
features.summary: A druid can lose a prepared spell to spontaneously cast any summon nature's ally spell of the same level or lower.

features.name: Animal Companion
features.summary: A druid gains a loyal animal companion that gains power as she advances; higher-level lists available from 4th on with a level adjustment.

features.name: Nature Sense
features.summary: A druid gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.

features.name: Wild Empathy
features.summary: A druid can improve an animal's attitude (1d20 + druid level + Cha mod), functioning like a Diplomacy check to influence a person.

features.name: Woodland Stride
features.summary: A druid may move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without damage or impairment (magically manipulated growth still affects her).

features.name: Trackless Step
features.summary: A druid leaves no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked (unless she chooses to leave a trail).

features.name: Resist Nature's Lure
features.summary: A druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against the spell-like abilities of fey.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: A druid can turn into a Small/Medium animal (then larger/other types and more uses as she levels), healing as if rested each time she changes; gear melds into the form.

features.name: Venom Immunity
features.summary: A druid gains immunity to all poisons.

features.name: A Thousand Faces
features.summary: A druid can change her appearance at will (as disguise self) while in her normal form.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.summary: A druid no longer takes ability penalties for aging and cannot be magically aged (prior penalties remain).

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d8 (mid pool), 3/4 BAB, light/medium (non-metal) + wooden-shield proficiency. CASTER-LAYER: divine spells (Wis), full prepared progression + spontaneous summon -> defer (FULL divine envelope). REINTERPRET: Wild Shape = a form-swap mechanic (heavy to implement; defer — would swap the HeroStats data object for a beast stat block); Animal Companion = a persistent summoned ally (a second controllable unit). Venom Immunity/Resist Nature's Lure = flat resist flags. Woodland Stride = ignore terrain-slow (maps to the move-through-clutter idea, cf. Tumble in skills.json). Not a Regauntless hero.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 1st level a fighter gets a bonus combat-oriented feat, and an additional bonus feat at 2nd and every two levels thereafter (4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, 18th, 20th), drawn from the fighter bonus feat list; prerequisites still apply.

regauntless.note: CLEANEST mapping — this is the WARRIOR hero. d10 (big pool), full BAB (fast fire-rate cadence per combat.md), full armor+shield proficiency (heavy armor = best mitigation). The only 'class feature' is Bonus Feats = a pile of extra combat FEATS, which is EXACTLY the character-creation.md primitive: a fighter is literally 'a grant source that grants many combat feats' — nothing to reinterpret, it ports as 'gets more feat picks' (fighterBonus tag already in feats.json). The purest grant-bundle. Warrior=Fighter; Valkyrie leans Fighter-ish too (best armor, balanced).

proficiencies.weapons: Club, crossbow (light or heavy), dagger, handaxe, javelin, kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, shuriken, siangham, and sling.
proficiencies.armor: None (wearing armor/shield or a medium-or-heavy load loses AC bonus, fast movement, and flurry of blows).

features.name: AC Bonus
features.summary: When unarmored and unencumbered, the monk adds her Wisdom bonus to AC, plus +1 at 5th level rising by +1 per five levels (to +4 at 20th).

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.summary: When unarmored, the monk may make one extra attack per round at her highest BAB (and a second extra at 11th via Greater Flurry), but all attacks that round take a penalty (-2, lessening to -1 at 5th, gone at 9th).

features.name: Unarmed Strike
features.summary: A monk gains Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat, deals escalating unarmed damage (1d6 up to 2d10), applies full Str to all unarmed strikes, and may deal lethal or nonlethal at will.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 1st level choose Improved Grapple or Stunning Fist; at 2nd Combat Reflexes or Deflect Arrows; at 6th Improved Disarm or Improved Trip (no prerequisites needed).

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: On a successful Reflex save against an attack that normally deals half damage on a save, the monk instead takes no damage (light/no armor only).

features.name: Fast Movement
features.summary: A monk gains an enhancement bonus to speed (+10 ft up to +60 ft) when unarmored and not carrying a medium/heavy load.

features.name: Still Mind
features.summary: A monk gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

features.name: Ki Strike
features.summary: A monk's unarmed attacks count as magic weapons for overcoming DR (then lawful at 10th, adamantine at 16th).

features.name: Slow Fall
features.summary: Within arm's reach of a wall, a monk treats a fall as shorter (20 ft at 4th, improving to any distance at 20th).

features.name: Purity of Body
features.summary: A monk gains immunity to all diseases except supernatural and magical ones.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.summary: A monk can heal her own wounds, up to twice her monk level in hit points per day, spread among several uses.

features.name: Improved Evasion
features.summary: Evasion improves — the monk still takes no damage on a successful Reflex save and only half damage on a failed save.

features.name: Diamond Body
features.summary: A monk gains immunity to poisons of all kinds.

features.name: Abundant Step
features.summary: Once per day a monk can slip between spaces as dimension door (caster level one-half her monk level).

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.summary: A monk gains spell resistance equal to her monk level + 10.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.summary: Once per week, after damaging a target with an announced attack, the monk can later will it to die (Fortitude save negates) within monk-level days.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.summary: A monk no longer takes ability penalties for aging and cannot be magically aged (prior penalties remain).

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.summary: A monk can speak with any living creature.

features.name: Empty Body
features.summary: A monk can become ethereal (as etherealness) for 1 round per monk level per day, split across occasions.

features.name: Perfect Self
features.summary: A monk becomes an outsider and gains damage reduction 10/magic.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d8 (mid pool), 3/4 BAB, ALL-GOOD saves (best resist profile), no-armor (relies on Wis-to-AC). REINTERPRET: Flurry = extra fire-rate at an accuracy cost (ties to combat.md's fire-rate model — more attacks/cadence); Unarmed Strike escalating damage = a built-in weapon damage table; AC Bonus (Wis->AC) = a Wis-driven mitigation. Fast Movement = flat +move. Evasion/Improved Evasion, Still Mind, Diamond Body/Soul, Ki Strike, DR = resist/mitigation flags. Wholeness of Body = self-heal. Several high-level (Quivering Palm, Abundant Step, Empty Body) are exotic — defer. Referenced hero slot: the martial-artist.

features.name: Aura of Good
features.summary: The power of a paladin's aura of good equals her paladin level.

features.name: Detect Evil
features.summary: At will, a paladin can use detect evil as the spell.

features.name: Smite Evil
features.summary: Once per day (more as she levels, to 5/day at 20th) a paladin adds her Cha bonus to an attack roll and 1 extra damage per paladin level against an evil foe.

features.name: Divine Grace
features.summary: A paladin gains a bonus equal to her Charisma bonus on all saving throws.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.summary: A paladin with Cha 12+ heals (paladin level x Cha bonus) hit points per day by touch, dividable among recipients, or deals that as damage to undead.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.summary: A paladin is immune to fear; allies within 10 ft gain a +4 morale bonus on saves against fear while she is conscious.

features.name: Divine Health
features.summary: A paladin gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.

features.name: Turn Undead
features.summary: A paladin turns undead as a cleric three levels lower, usable 3 + Cha modifier times per day.

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A paladin gains a small number of prepared divine spells (Wis-based) from the paladin list; caster level is one-half her paladin level (none before 4th).

features.name: Special Mount
features.summary: A paladin can call a loyal, intelligent celestial steed once per day for 2 hours per paladin level.

features.name: Remove Disease
features.summary: A paladin can produce a remove disease effect once per week, plus one more use per week per three levels past 6th.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d10 (big pool), full BAB (fast cadence), full armor + shield (tanky). REINTERPRET: Smite Evil = a limited-use burst damage button vs evil enemies; Lay on Hands = a touch self/ally heal pool (ties to the revive/heal role, Heal is a class skill); Divine Grace = flat Cha-to-all-saves (sheet-level); Aura of Courage = party fear-immunity aura; Divine Health = disease-immune flag. CASTER-LAYER: paladin spells = the HALF/PARTIAL divine envelope per character-creation.md (starts L4, caster level = 1/2 class level) — the SRD-grounded 'dabbler-adjacent' progression; defer slot table. Special Mount = summoned ally (defer). Maps to Valkyrie's tanky-holy-warrior flavor; Paladin explicitly referenced as a hero archetype.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.summary: A ranger selects a creature type, gaining +2 on Bluff/Listen/Sense Motive/Spot/Survival and +2 weapon damage against it; another favored enemy and a +2 increase every five levels.

features.name: Track
features.summary: A ranger gains Track as a bonus feat.

features.name: Wild Empathy
features.summary: A ranger can improve an animal's attitude (1d20 + ranger level + Cha mod), functioning like a Diplomacy check to influence a person.

features.name: Combat Style
features.summary: A ranger chooses archery (treated as having Rapid Shot) or two-weapon combat (treated as having Two-Weapon Fighting), benefits only in light/no armor.

features.name: Endurance
features.summary: A ranger gains Endurance as a bonus feat.

features.name: Animal Companion
features.summary: A ranger gains an animal companion (as the druid ability) with an effective druid level equal to one-half his ranger level.

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A ranger gains a small number of prepared divine spells (Wis-based) from the ranger list; caster level is one-half his ranger level (none before 4th).

features.name: Improved Combat Style
features.summary: A ranger's style improves: archery is treated as having Manyshot, two-weapon combat as having Improved Two-Weapon Fighting (light/no armor only).

features.name: Woodland Stride
features.summary: A ranger may move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without damage or impairment (magically manipulated growth still affects him).

features.name: Swift Tracker
features.summary: A ranger can move at normal speed while tracking without the normal -5 penalty (only -10 at up to double speed).

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: On a successful Reflex save against an attack that normally deals half damage on a save, the ranger instead takes no damage (light/no armor only).

features.name: Combat Style Mastery
features.summary: A ranger's style improves again: archery is treated as having Improved Precise Shot, two-weapon combat as having Greater Two-Weapon Fighting (light/no armor only).

features.name: Camouflage
features.summary: A ranger can use Hide in any natural terrain, even without cover or concealment.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.summary: In natural terrain, a ranger can use Hide even while being observed.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d8 (mid pool), full BAB (fast cadence — fits a fast ranged hero), light-armor, two good saves (Fort+Ref). REINTERPRET: Combat Style archery chain (Rapid Shot -> Manyshot -> Improved Precise Shot) = fire-rate / multi-shot upgrades (clean fit to combat.md fire-rate and to the Elf's 'fastest fire-rate' flavor); Favored Enemy = conditional +damage vs an enemy type (the ±5/damage circumstance pile vs bestiary families); Evasion = Reflex-save mitigation. CASTER-LAYER: ranger spells = HALF/PARTIAL divine envelope (L4, caster level = 1/2) — defer. Animal Companion = summoned ally (defer). The ranged-martial fits ELF; archery combat-style is the Elf's bow fantasy.

proficiencies.weapons: All simple weapons, plus hand crossbow, rapier, sap, shortbow, and short sword.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.summary: When a target is denied its Dex bonus to AC or the rogue flanks it, the rogue deals +1d6 extra damage, increasing by +1d6 every two rogue levels (to +10d6 at 19th); ranged only within 30 ft; not vs crit-immune foes.

features.name: Trapfinding
features.summary: Rogues (and only rogues) can use Search to find traps with DC higher than 20 and use Disable Device to disarm magic traps.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: On a successful Reflex save against an attack that normally deals half damage on a save, the rogue instead takes no damage (light/no armor only).

features.name: Trap Sense
features.summary: +1 bonus on Reflex saves and +1 dodge bonus to AC against traps; rises +1 at 6th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: A rogue retains her Dexterity bonus to AC even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker (but not if immobilized).

features.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: A rogue can no longer be flanked (denying another rogue the flanking sneak attack unless the attacker has four+ more rogue levels).

features.name: Special Ability
features.summary: At 10th level and every three levels thereafter (13th, 16th, 19th) a rogue gains a special ability of her choice: Crippling Strike, Defensive Roll, Improved Evasion, Opportunist, Skill Mastery, Slippery Mind, or a bonus feat.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d6 (small pool), 3/4 BAB, light armor, HUGE skill-points (8+Int — the skill class), Use Magic Device is a class skill. REINTERPRET: Sneak Attack = conditional burst damage (positional: flanking / target-denied-Dex) — scales via a dice table (character-creation.md's 'grant references a scaling table'); in our model, likely a backstab/positional damage bonus. Evasion/Improved Evasion/Uncanny Dodge = Reflex/positional mitigation. NO-OP-ish: Trapfinding/Trap Sense (no trap subsystem yet). KEY to character-creation.md: the Rogue is the 'fake-a-caster via UMD + item' path (capability-as-outcome, third way to cast). Rogue explicitly referenced as a hero archetype; fits the Elf's fast-squishy-skirmisher side too.

proficiencies.armor: None (armor can cause arcane spell failure for spells with somatic components).

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A sorcerer casts arcane spells (Cha-based) from the sorcerer/wizard list spontaneously, without preparation; a limited, fixed number of spells known; save DC = 10 + spell level + Cha mod.

features.name: Summon Familiar
features.summary: A sorcerer can obtain a familiar — a magical beast companion that grants its master special abilities scaling with level.

regauntless.note: CLEAN: d4 (smallest pool — squishiest), 1/2 BAB (slowest cadence — a caster, not a shooter in the martial sense), no armor. CASTER-LAYER: arcane spells (Cha) spontaneous, FULL arcane envelope (max slots/day, fixed limited spells-known) -> defer to caster layer; the spontaneous-Cha caster is the character-creation.md note on Cha->spontaneous arcane. REINTERPRET: Familiar = a persistent companion granting a passive buff (defer). Maps to the WIZARD hero's 'strong magic, weak shot/armor' profile (Sorcerer = the spontaneous-casting variant of that fantasy).

proficiencies.weapons: Club, dagger, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, and quarterstaff.
proficiencies.armor: None (armor can cause arcane spell failure for spells with somatic components).

features.name: Spells
features.summary: A wizard casts arcane spells (Int-based), prepared in advance from her spellbook; save DC = 10 + spell level + Int mod; may know any number of spells recorded in her spellbook.

features.name: Summon Familiar
features.summary: A wizard can obtain a familiar in the same manner as a sorcerer — a magical beast companion granting scaling abilities.

features.name: Scribe Scroll
features.summary: A wizard gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat at 1st level.

features.name: Spellbooks
features.summary: A wizard must study her spellbook daily to prepare spells and cannot prepare spells not recorded in it (except read magic); she adds two new spells per level.

features.name: School Specialization
features.summary: A wizard may specialize in one of eight schools, gaining an extra spell of that school per level and +2 Spellcraft to learn its spells, but giving up two (or one, for divination) prohibited schools.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level a wizard gains a bonus feat chosen from metamagic feats, item creation feats, or Spell Mastery (prerequisites still apply).

regauntless.note: The WIZARD hero. CLEAN: d4 (smallest pool — 'weak shot/armor'), 1/2 BAB (slowest martial cadence; damage comes from spells not swings), no armor. CASTER-LAYER: arcane spells (Int), FULL arcane envelope, prepared from a spellbook + school specialization -> defer to caster layer (Int->arcane per character-creation.md/abilities.json). REINTERPRET: Scribe Scroll/Bonus metamagic+item feats = feat grants into the pile (clean, character-creation.md primitive) + the item-economy layer (defer). Familiar = passive-buff companion (defer). Wizard=Wizard; the archetypal glass-cannon ranged-magic hero ('strong magic, weak shot/armor').
